systems.country_label: Carte nationale d'identité biométrique sécurisée; its 'base de données carte d'identité' holds the fingerprints
systems.tiers: Issued or renewed by police commissioners, gendarmerie brigade commanders and sub-prefects; abroad by heads of diplomatic and consular missions

note: The decree institutes the biometric identity card; it names the birth certificate extract only as a document produced at first application and says nothing on how births or deaths are registered.
